# go-discord-caller

> Free, source-available Discord shot caller and voice relay bot written in Go. One caller's voice is relayed live to many squad voice channels across one or many Discord servers, with mix-minus conference mode and DAVE end-to-end encryption. Free to self-host (Elastic License 2.0); a free hosted bot has limited speakers.

- [Home](https://go-discord-caller.sealbro.dev/): overview, modes, setup
